summary: TASK-019: SEO Tools Integration - Successfully implemented comprehensive SEO analysis and optimization capabilities for the Auto Claude Marketing framework. Created SEO agent, system prompt, and integration modules with support for keyword research, on-page analysis, backlink tracking, competitor analysis, and rank tracking.
current_status: TASK-019 COMPLETED - All acceptance criteria met
acceptance_criteria: Keyword research - Implemented with KeywordResearcher class supporting search volume, difficulty, opportunity scoring, and search intent classification
On-page SEO analysis - Implemented with OnPageAnalyzer class providing title tag, meta description, heading structure, content optimization, and technical SEO checks
Backlink tracking - Implemented with BacklinkTracker class for profile analysis, link gap analysis, and opportunity identification
Competitor analysis - Implemented with CompetitorAnalyzer class for keyword gaps, content strategies, and backlink comparison
Rank tracking - Implemented with RankTracker class for position monitoring, visibility scoring, and trend analysis
key_features: SEO Agent (seo_agent.py) - Main agent orchestrator with task-specific runners (run_keyword_research, run_on_page_analysis, run_competitor_seo_analysis, run_rank_tracking)
SEO System Prompt (seo.md) - Comprehensive prompt covering all SEO disciplines with campaign context integration
SEO Integration Modules - Modular design with config, keyword_research, on_page_analyzer, backlink_tracker, competitor_analyzer, and rank_tracker
API Integration Support - Configuration for SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, and Google Search Console APIs (with built-in fallbacks)
Data-Driven Analysis - Opportunity scoring, traffic estimation, readability scoring, and keyword density calculations
Content Creator Integration - SEO insights feed into content creation via SEO content briefs
integration_points: Claude Agent SDK - SEO agent uses create_client() with agent_type='seo_agent'
Graphiti Memory - SEO insights stored in memory/ for cross-session learning
Content Creator Agent - SEO briefs provide keywords, title tags, meta descriptions, and heading structure
Campaign Planner - SEO analysis informs campaign strategy and content planning
